type: {σ : Type u_1} → ℝ → (σ → ℕ) → Set (MvPolynomial σ ℤ)
what: Nonzero integer multivariate polynomials with individual degrees bounded by r and every real-cast coefficient absolute value bounded by B.
how: Constructs a Set by conjoining nonzero, degreeOf bounds, and all coefficient absolute-value bounds. The degree component is equivalent to the carrier of MvPolynomial.restrictSupport ℤ {d | ∀ j, d j ≤ r j}; this needs degreeOf_le_iff plus quantifier reordering, not a definitional replacement of the whole set.
hypotheses: Arbitrary universe-polymorphic σ, B : ℝ, r : σ → ℕ; no Fintype, DecidableEq, positivity, or finite-support assumption is captured.

caller_summary.scope: 293 canonical source declarations only; not full transitive or simp closure

mathlib_api_audit.limitations: Online revision may differ. Local search reports index unavailable. No complete ≤3 existing-call replacement verified.

moral_duplications: Degree component is the existing restrictSupport carrier.
Finite coefficient-array boxes compose with Finset.finsupp under extra finite exponent-box data.
Polynomial.supNorm is univariate; projective Height and ℓ¹ norm are not the same bound.

generalization.status: already broad variable/bound parameters; no mechanically droppable instance
generalization.verified: Generic degree/support bridge over arbitrary σ and CommSemiring; not a generic arithmetic development.
generalization.rejected: Do not replace by total degree, projective height, submodule including zero, or finite box without extra assumptions.

missing_api: Potential generic multivariate naive coefficient-height interface and support/degree bridges; not an established upstream design.
junk: Retain: live local arithmetic API; no dead-code/deletion recommendation. For B<0 the set is empty; zero is always excluded. Zero degree limits and empty/infinite variable types are valid inputs. All coefficients, including absent ones, are tested.

action.recommendation: Retain the local stable name; choose generic upstream coefficient-height/support API before proposing this exact intersection. No edits requested.
